title: The Roadside Shrine
text: A little shrine to no saint you know, its carving worn smooth by weather and hands. It is kept clean by no one you can see. There are fresh flowers on it, still wet with dew, though nothing grows for miles.

options.label: Kneel together before the nameless saint, and hope it is kind.

outcomes.text: Nothing answers, yet you all rise feeling fortunate. No one says so aloud for fear of losing it.
Nothing answers, but the rest among the fresh flowers eases your aching wounds.

options.label: The bravest takes the fresh flowers, curious what keeps them alive.

outcomes.text: The flowers keep for a year without wilting. So does the courage of the one who carries them.
They wilt at once in the bravest's hand. Something within them wilts too, never to return.

options.label: The Knight keeps vigil at it through the night, as knights once did.

outcomes.text: No saint answers. Even so, the Knight rises from the vigil hard as the shrine's stones.
